
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/20058232" title="发布于 2026-05-16 10:55">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript之匿名类型与动态类型</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="buTZEBuA">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，其中有两种数据类型比较特殊：<strong>匿名类型</strong>和<strong>动态类型</strong>。</p>
<h1 id="h_2038012822622360499_0">一、匿名类型</h1>
<p data-pid="3bXlzzTg">匿名类型是在编译时确定结构，适合固定数据结构，属性只读。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var a = new { Name='tony', Age=20 }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a.Name + ':' + a.Age
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tony:20</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, script.Eval(s));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dynamic</span> a = script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取脚本中定义的匿名类型</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> type = Script.AnonymousTypes.CreateType(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> }, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>), <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Assert.IsInstanceOfType(a, type);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tony</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, a.Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, a.Age);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{ Name = tony, Age = 20 }</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, a.ToString());</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="W3Ly3sN1">可以从&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Script.AnonymousTypes</span>&nbsp;中获取脚本内定义的匿名类型。</p>
<p data-pid="zaRumWtF">匿名类型也常用于LINQ查询：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var q = from a in context.Persons
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    join b in context.AddressInfos on a.Id equals b.UserId into bb
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    from b in bb.DefaultIfEmpty()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    select new { a.Id, a.Name, a.Age, MyAddress = b.Address };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">q.ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据库DbContext变量</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">context</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, context);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = script.Eval&lt;IList&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> Console.WriteLine(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(list, Formatting.Indented));</pre>
</div>
<p>匿名类型实现详见源码：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">AnonymousTypeManager</span>&nbsp;</p>
<h1 id="h_2038012822622360499_1">二、动态类型</h1>
<p data-pid="U7K3Twne">动态类型&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">ExpandoObject</span>&nbsp;，运行时可动态添加属性，对应js中的写法：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> a = { }</span>&nbsp;。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var a = new ExpandoObject();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a.Name = 'jim';
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a.Age = 23;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dynamic</span> a =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> Assert.IsInstanceOfType(a, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(ExpandoObject));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jim</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, a.Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">23</span>, a.Age);</pre>
</div>
<p>使用初始化器创建动态类型：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var a = new ExpandoObject { Name = 'jim', Age = 23 };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a.Height= 170;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dynamic</span> a =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> Assert.IsInstanceOfType(a, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(ExpandoObject));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jim</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, a.Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">23</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, a.Age);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">170</span>, a.Height);</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="aBOMVd76">AScript 的匿名类型和动态类型为脚本提供了灵活的数据结构表达能力。</p>
